items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I had a chance to get a load of Blanco and Pons... So I took him on. And he come on and down with a little bit of bass and trumpet... I brought to the band.

ctx.x: Natural born musician, but he didn't need it. People had money. And they had a jam session. And I had a chance to get a load of Blanco and Pons. And I was delighted. So I said, Blanco, do you know who I am? He says, I believe you're Johnny DeGroote. I said, I am. He said, Mr. DeGroote, I'm so happy to meet you. I said, I don't need a lamp. I said, but I do need a trumpet player. Will you play with me? He almost fainted. I can't. I don't raise your bed. I said, that's for me to judge. So I took him on. And he come…
I wanted to ask you one thing before I forget it. Did you take any choruses with Arnold Johnson on the records?
